ogtr:DIR-220.name: DIR 220 — GM multivalent cat vaccine, commercial supply
ogtr:DIR-220.desc: Commercial supply of multivalent cat vaccines containing a genetically modified component, for prevention of feline leukaemia virus infection. A commercial-supply licence is national in scope, so there is no site to place — the marker sits at the country centroid. A separate Intervet application for a GM multivalent chicken vaccine was pending at the time this record was written.
